cohort: The study included 226 pregnant patients with preeclampsia who delivered by cesarean section between January 2017 and December 2021.
finding: Fetal growth restriction was detected in 37.6% of women with preeclampsia, and a weak statistically significant positive correlation was found between gestational age at delivery and FGR.
gest_age: The mean gestational age at delivery was 34 weeks and 6 days.
